status.note: Proposed in .ai/maps/proposals/Avatar.md from the Figma set 4284:256. The first contract whose visibility depends on an OBSERVED outcome rather than a value anyone sets: the picture shows only once it has loaded. Any backend that cannot observe load and error is non-conforming for that promise (ADR 0005); this contract rejects it through emission.resourceObservation.

intent.purpose: Stands for a person or entity in a small fixed frame: their picture when one is available, their initial otherwise.
behaviour: Shows the supplied picture once it has loaded.
Shows the initial whenever the picture is not showing: nothing supplied, or the picture failed to load.
Never shows the picture and the initial at the same time.
notFor: A control. An avatar that opens a profile menu is a button that contains an avatar.
Status or presence marks. Those are separate indicators this contract does not describe.
Several initials. The design sizes the frame for one character, and two overflow the small size.

size.description: The frame's size. The design measures 24, 32 and 40.

shape.description: The frame's silhouette. When each applies is not decided.

image-status.description: What happened to the supplied picture. Observed, never set: `absent` while there is no source or the current one has not finished loading, `loaded` once it has, `failed` if it could not.
image-status.visual: The picture shows only while `loaded`; the initial shows otherwise.

a11y.keyboard: Not focusable. An avatar is not a control.
notes: The root carries one accessible name for both outcomes, supplied by the consumer — `aria-label` on the web. The picture inside is decorative, so the name is not announced twice, and a lone initial is never announced on its own.
An avatar beside a visible name is decorative and must be hidden from assistive technology by the consumer — `aria-hidden` on the web. Nothing here detects a missing name or a redundant one.
`failed` must fall back to the initial. A backend that cannot observe load or error cannot keep that promise and must refuse to emit this contract rather than show an empty frame.
Contrast of the initial against the frame is not claimed. The design binds both to variables this repository does not map.

children.description: None. The picture and the initial arrive through their slots.

image.description: The picture's source. Optional: without one, the initial shows.

fallback.description: The initial. One character, per the design.

root.description: The frame. Owns size and silhouette, and holds whichever of the picture or the initial is showing. Clipping to the silhouette is layout, which the contract cannot express yet.

image.description: The picture. How it fills the frame is the `object-fit` paint, supplied by the consumer.

fallback.description: The initial. Centring it in the frame is layout, which the contract cannot express yet.
